title: Electronics and home SKUs excluding refurbished
prompt: Return the name (column: name) of products whose sku starts with 'ELEC-' or starts with 'HOME-', but exclude any product whose name contains the word 'Refurbished'.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, sku TEXT); INSERT INTO products VALUES (1,'Wireless Mouse','ELEC-1001'),(2,'Refurbished Laptop','ELEC-1002'),(3,'Toaster Oven','HOME-2001'),(4,'Refurbished Blender','HOME-2002'),(5,'Desk Lamp','HOME-2003'),(6,'Garden Hose','OUT-3001'),(7,'Bluetooth Speaker','ELEC-1003');
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE (sku LIKE 'ELEC-%' OR sku LIKE 'HOME-%') AND name NOT LIKE '%Refurbished%';
